profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Echelon Fitness Multimedia, LLC
profile.summary:
A forward-thinking Full Stack Software Engineer specialized in JavaScript, Typescript, Angular,  Node.js, NestJs, React, MySQL, MongoDB. Passionate about learning and coding, with a desire to apply skills on an enterprise level.

Software Engineer | Front & Back End | JavaScript | Typescript | Angular | RXJS | React | MERN | MEAN | Node.js | NestJs | MySQL | MongoDB

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for developing and maintaining complex web applications that serve both front-end and back-end needs. My work involves a strong focus on the following technologies:
➤ Front-End Development: Utilizing Angular, TypeScript, and JavaScript to create responsive, user-friendly interfaces.
➤ Reactive Programming: Leveraging RxJS to handle asynchronous data streams and manage state effectively.
➤ Component Library Development: Leading the development of a component library using Angular and Storybook, which is utilized across all portals and interfaces to ensure consistency and reusability.
➤ Back-End Development: Implementing server-side logic with NestJS and integrating it with RESTful APIs.
➤ Full Stack Collaboration: Working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver features from concept to deployment.
➤ Code Quality: Ensuring high standards of performance and maintainability through code reviews and thorough testing.
Through this role, I have enhanced my expertise in building scalable and efficient web applications and component libraries that meet client needs and drive business success.

positions.title: University of Central Florida Coding Bootcamp Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Assist the lead instructor with preparation and facilitation of classes for students attending UCF's Full Stack Web Development Coding Bootcamp Program.
➤	Topics of subjects taught include: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6), Node.js, Express, React, jQuery, Bootstrap, Firebase, MySQL, MongoDB, REST APIs, MVC, Handlebars, PHP, PHP Frameworks, Jest, PWA's, App Optimization, Agile, Scrum & GitHub Version Control Platform.
➤	Liaison with the class lead instructor to develop detailed plans, providing regular feedback on the student’s work, assisting with students to reach their academic achievements, and helping to evaluate learning activities. 
➤	Train and mentor over 20+ students daily, each over a 3-month period, to design and develop user-friendly applications. These students go on to start coding careers at well-respected companies in the industry. 
➤	Provide support to students by reviewing web applications and assisting them with troubleshooting issues and fixing application functionality.
➤	Deliver weekly coding sessions and reviews to help the students understand and develop coding techniques.
➤	Distinguished as an excellent Teaching Assistant and invited to teach at two classes simultaneously (Full-Time and Part-Time).

positions.title: Instructor - Lab Specialist
positions.description:
➤	Taught students how to utilize Music Software Applications to be used to write and produce Music. 
➤	Formally commended by Program Director for leading students to successfully complete class objectives.
➤	Provided support to over 200 students monthly with equipment and software set up as well as implementing troubleshooting techniques to solve computer and/or software issues.
➤	Prepared students for success when taking various standardized tests required by the state.

positions.title: Website Design / Web Maintenance / Graphic Design
positions.description: ➤ Creation, design and maintenance of web pages. From securing the domain name, to setting up a hosting account and uploading all web content.
